ModMetaData.name: Orc Clan + Xenotype
ModMetaData.author: Karew
ModMetaData.description:
Adds a new orc clan faction and an orc xenotype.

The orc clans are proud, industrial-era rimworld denizens who heavily favor melee combat. Battle the orcs as raiders or become their trade partner and ally.

All genes are inheritable, and orcs are an available xenotype at colony start.
